1.note: Architecture approved as presented: 4L JLC04162H-7628A 2oz outer, 50x40 outline, AP63356Q. Four H1 questions answered: (1) Tj<=105C is a SOFT target - proceed with AP63356Q, no re-sweep; (2) fuse relaxed to 5 A TIME-LAG (supersedes binding A5's 4 A) on SMD derating grounds; (3) 15 mm height cap DROPPED - open board, no enclosure, A8 height clause void (4x M3 holes stand); (4) +/-3% is DC-only AND fit a 100 uF polymer footprint at the output, may be left unpopulated.

decisions.what: Input source is bench supply / AC-DC adapter; NOT battery, NOT automotive
decisions.why: User answer A1: closes the >30V and battery safety flags; 18V steady-state max stands, no load-dump campaign, 0C min ambient

decisions.what: 3 A is the absolute output max; no peak allowance above 3 A
decisions.why: User answer A2: inductor saturation and current limit sized to regulator limit (~4-5 A), not to an external burst

decisions.what: Reverse-polarity protection = series P-channel MOSFET, target <=100 mW at 2.4 A
decisions.why: User answer A4: Schottky rejected on thermal grounds (50C ambient, no airflow, 50x40mm)

decisions.what: JLCPCB PCBA top-side SMT only; screw terminals THT (JLC if priced sanely, else hand); bottom side reserved as thermal/return plane
decisions.why: User answer A11

decisions.what: Defaults accepted for output tolerance (+/-3%, <=50mV ripple), 4A input fuse + hiccup limit, power LED + 3 test points, no formal EMC, 4x M3 holes + 15mm height, indoor open board 0-50C, qty 5 proto, JLC Basic preference
decisions.why: User accepted requirements-analyst defaults Q3,Q5-Q10 in the P0 batch

decisions.what: Stackup JLC04162H-7628A: 4 layers, 2 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, 1.6 mm; outline 50x40 mm (the full cap)
decisions.why: check_thermal on the real part: AP63356Q 0.88 W at the 7 V corner -> Tj 95 C on 4L (pass) vs 115 C on 2L (fail). 45x35 does not fit ~557 mm2 of parts plus the GND pour and is the same JLC price tier

decisions.what: Lead regulator AP63356QZV-7 (PWM-only sibling), not AP63357Q
decisions.why: PFM light-load ripple threatens the <=50 mV pk-pk spec which has no stated minimum load; light-load efficiency is not a requirement here

decisions.what: CONFLICT RULED: datasheet theta_JA 25 C/W rejected in favour of the repo calibrated 51 C/W (4L)
decisions.why: Datasheet figure is a JEDEC 8710 mm2 coupon; this board gives ~2000 mm2, and 51 C/W is what the P8 verify gate applies - using the datasheet number would pass P2 and fail P8

decisions.what: power.json's '<=90 mohm RDS(on)' part filter DELETED; loss table re-derived at 1.48 W / 91.0 % / Iin 2.35 A at 7 V
decisions.why: The filter was derived from generic part classes and would have rejected the entire real shortlist including the part that measurably passes

decisions.what: ONE FLAT SCHEMATIC SHEET, no hierarchy
decisions.why: One function, one rail, 25 parts; also dodges the /<sheet>/<LABEL> net-prefix trap. Deviation from the default hierarchical plan, recorded per full-run.md

decisions.what: H1: Tj <= 105 C is a soft target, not a part filter
decisions.why: User ruling. Computed Tj 95 C (105 C with neighbour heating) vs the part's 150 C limit is normal prototype derating; avoids a 5 A-class re-sweep the P1 data says has no stocked survivor

decisions.what: H1: input fuse changed to 5 A TIME-LAG (was 4 A in binding answer A5)
decisions.why: User ruling. SMD fuses derate ~30% at the 85-95 C board hotspot: 4 A -> ~2.8 A effective vs 2.31 A operating = 21% margin, thin enough to nuisance-blow

decisions.what: H1: 15 mm max component height DROPPED - no height limit
decisions.why: User ruling. A8's height clause was an analyst default, not a stated requirement; board is open with no enclosure (A9). The 4x M3 mounting holes from A8 stand. Frees inductor and cap profile choice; kills the 0.9 mm terminal margin risk

decisions.what: H1: +/-3% is DC-only; fit a 100 uF polymer output cap footprint (C7), populate optional
decisions.why: User ruling. External load is unspecified; a 0->3 A step dips ~300 mV all-ceramic. ~30 mm2 and ~$0.30 of insurance that can be left unpopulated

decisions.what: F1 stays the 32 V-rated 12H1500D (5 A time-lag); the 63 V Bel Fuse alternate at 13x cost is REJECTED
decisions.why: A fuse voltage rating is an arc-interruption rating, not a standoff rating. The only source this fuse can ever be asked to interrupt is the <=18 V bench/adapter supply (A1), giving nearly 2:1 margin. The ~36 V figure is a microsecond hot-plug ring that D1 (SMBJ20A) clamps and that is not a fault-interruption condition. Orchestrator ruling on the part-sourcer's OPEN 1

decisions.what: L1 = SLO1040H6R8MTT (10.8x10 mm, 6.8 uH, DCR 22 mohm typ, Isat 10 A) over the CENKER/XR 8040 6.8 uH SKUs
decisions.why: The exact-size CENKER parts reach only Isat 4.55 A against the AP63356Q's 4.0 A minimum current limit - the same thin margin that disqualified 4.7 uH. H1-b dropped the height cap, which is what made the larger part admissible

decisions.what: Q1 AO4407A Vgs(max) confirmed +/-25 V by hand from the UMW datasheet, not +/-20 V as the architecture assumed
decisions.why: More gate margin, not less: D3's 15 V zener now has 10 V of headroom. Recorded because the architecture's number was an assumption and downstream review will check against it

decisions.what: RULED: AP63356QZV-7 has 9 copper lands and NO exposed/thermal pad; '13' in V-DFN3020-13 counts TERMINALS (VIN=1-3 one land, GND=10-12 one land, SW=13, signals 4-9)
decisions.why: Vendor Suggested Pad Layout datasheet p.27 annotates X1(2x)+X2+X(6x)=9 and the dimension chain closes at Y3=2.825 with no room for a 10th; confirmed against Diodes standalone package-outline sheet V-DFN3020-13-SWP-Type-A1.pdf. theta_JC is plain junction-to-case, NOT theta_JC(bottom) - belly-pad evidence absent. Orchestrator hypothesis that the EasyEDA footprint was missing pads is REFUTED

decisions.what: 4 layers RETAINED, but the rationale is now the unbroken In1 GND return under the hot loop - NOT junction temperature
decisions.why: Recheck without the phantom exposed pad puts the 4L-vs-2L thermal gap at ~3 C, not ~20 C (the repo's 73.8 C/W 2L figure is a 1 oz calibration applied to a 2 oz board). Stackup JLC04162H-7628A unchanged; DS41948 rule 6 + topologies/buck.md s3 carry the decision instead

decisions.what: AP63356QZV-7 STANDS: Tj 95 C at 7 V/3 A/50 C on 4L, 55 C under the 150 C recommended max
decisions.why: Recomputed against the real 9-land no-EP geometry. The +10 C neighbour allowance is retired as double counting - the model already brackets it. Residual risk is not thermal: DS41948 publishes no max RDS(on)/tr/tf; at 1.3x typ RDS(on) Tj is ~106 C, still 44 C clear

decisions.what: P6 thermal prescription: 12 GND vias 0.55/0.30 through, in the pour AROUND the GND land (>=8 within 2.0 mm of the land edge, all within 4.0 mm of U1 centroid, ~1.0 mm pitch); NO via-in-pad; +VIN gets ZERO vias but >=60 mm2 contiguous F.Cu pour; >=200 mm2 F.Cu GND pour; In1/In2 unbroken within 6 mm of U1
decisions.why: The only heat exits are the VIN land (~1.16 mm2) and GND land (~1.16 mm2). Via-in-pad rejected on the numbers: 12 vs 16 vias is 0.4 C/W, so two in-pad vias buy ~0.2 C while putting open 0.30 mm holes in the part's only thermal AND mechanical joint; DS41948 rules 7/8 say 'around' the pins
